items.prompt: Picture 1 is the character design reference — copy his costume, mask, single golden eye, proportions and gold patterns faithfully (but not its background, and not its halo). MONBAN, the gatekeeper of a secret order: a tall, imposing, motionless figure in a long black hooded robe that falls to the floor, layered like a ceremonial mantle with wide hanging sleeves. The black cloth is heavy and rich (velvet and brocade with a faint woven pattern); along every hem, seam and the edge of the hood run fine lines of real metallic gold embroidery, and down the centre of the chest hangs a vertical chain of small engraved gold magic-circle emblems (circles with compass stars) joined by a thin gold line, with thin gold cords and tassels at the sleeves. Deep inside the hood the whole face is covered by a black mask of layered cloth and dark metal plates with thin gold edges; in the middle of its forehead is ONE single eye made of polished gold — an engraved metallic golden eye with a gold iris, like jewellery. The eye is NOT a lamp: it does not glow, has no rays, no bloom, no halo and lights nothing around it; it only carries one tiny bright specular point of light, as polished metal does. There is no second eye, no nose, no mouth, no skin anywhere. Black gloves with fine gold trim on the knuckles and cuffs; black boots with gold trim. Pose: standing perfectly still and upright, facing the viewer, arms down at his sides inside the wide sleeves, gloved hands just visible. Calm, silent, watchful. Background: a completely flat, solid, pure chroma-key green (#00FF00) everywhere around him, no gradient, no floor, no ground shadow, no smoke, no mist, no light spill, no glow outside the figure, no other objects. Nothing on the character is green; no green reflections on the gold or the black cloth. The whole body is in the picture, centred, seen straight from the front at eye level, from the tip of the hood to the hem of the robe and the boots with a small margin, the hem near the bottom, the figure fills about 88% of the picture's height. Realistic dark fantasy, the quality of a high-end 3DCG film character render (physically based materials: matte black cloth, fine gold thread, brushed and polished gold metal), extremely detailed, crisp and sharp, rich but restrained — gold appears only as thin lines and small ornaments on black. Soft, even studio key light from the front with a faint cool rim light so the black folds read clearly; no coloured light. There is NO halo, NO ring, NO magic circle and NO disc behind his head in this picture (the reference shows one — leave it out completely; it is added later as a separate layer). No text, no letters, no numbers, no writing, no logo, no watermark, no signature anywhere.
